result.explanation: Use a finite controller state: newest observation time, mode, warning kind/ID, hysteresis counters, and acknowledged IDs. Newer observations alone advance time; critical observations take priority unless acknowledged. Normal hysteresis operates only while enabled and no critical warning is visible.
result.mapping: config thresholds map to up/down consecutive-normal counters; state stores lastTime, enabled, visible kind/id, counters, and acknowledged IDs; event types transition these variables; output projects visibility, kind, and critical ID.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the published validity constraints. IDs are compared by exact string equality. Initial state is null and all supplied events are processed synchronously in order.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var s=null;for(var i=0;i<output.length;i++){var r=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});s=r.state;var a=r.output,b=output[i];if(!b||b.visible!==a.visible||b.kind!==a.kind||b.id!==a.id)return false}return true}
